copias_seguridad_estado_compatible: The declared versions are compatible. Authenticity and an isolated restore still need to be verified.
copias_seguridad_estado_incompatible: The declared versions are incompatible. Resolve the differences before preparing a restore.
copias_seguridad_estado_no_comprobable: Compatibility cannot be checked. Complete or correct the inventory.
copias_seguridad_error_entrada: The comparison could not be read. Check the format and required fields.
copias_seguridad_error_argumentos: Invalid arguments. Use -catalogo followed by the catalogue path, or provide no arguments.
copias_seguridad_error_catalogo: The text catalogue could not be read. Check the file and its keys.
copias_seguridad_error_salida: The result could not be written. Check the output destination.
copias_seguridad_razon_dato_no_comprobab: Required information is missing or an inventory value is invalid.
copias_seguridad_razon_esquema_migracion: The installed schema or migrations differ from the declared set.
copias_seguridad_razon_migracion_huella_: A migration has the same identifier but different content.
copias_seguridad_razon_esquema_huella_di: A module structure differs from the declared structure.
copias_seguridad_razon_release_diferente: The application release differs from the declared release.
copias_seguridad_razon_commit_diferente: The binary source revision differs from the declared revision.
copias_seguridad_razon_plataforma_difere: The destination platform does not match the archived set.
copias_seguridad_razon_binarios_diferent: The installed binaries differ from the declared binaries.
copias_seguridad_razon_componentes_difer: The application files differ from the declared files.
copias_seguridad_razon_postgresql_versio: The exact PostgreSQL version does not match.
copias_seguridad_razon_runtime_diferente: PostgreSQL, its tools or extensions differ from the declared set.
copias_seguridad_razon_cluster_diferente: The observed source does not match the declared source.
copias_seguridad_razon_bases_diferentes: The destination databases do not match the complete backup scope.
copias_seguridad_razon_almacenes_diferen: The stores do not match the declared stores.
copias_seguridad_razon_modo_no_admitido: This version requires the complete set, including the application.
copias_seguridad_razon_inventario_huella: The inventory does not match the digest recorded in the manifest.
copias_seguridad_razon_release_incomplet: The backup does not contain all archived release files.
copias_seguridad_razon_runtime_no_admiti: The current policy does not allow this exact PostgreSQL and tool combination.
copias_seguridad_razon_release_no_admiti: The current policy does not allow this exact application release.
copias_seguridad_razon_release_revocada: The archived release is revoked and cannot be recovered.
copias_seguridad_accion_preparar_conjunt: Prepare a backup of the complete set.
copias_seguridad_accion_preparar_actuali: Prepare and test a separate upgrade procedure.
copias_seguridad_accion_recuperar_releas: Recover the archived release binaries as well.
copias_seguridad_accion_preparar_destino: Prepare a destination compatible with the set.
copias_seguridad_accion_preparar_runtime: Prepare the same exact PostgreSQL and tool versions.
copias_seguridad_accion_comprobar_integr: Check the inventory and backup integrity.
copias_seguridad_accion_preparar_cluster: Prepare a dedicated cluster for the backup scope.
copias_seguridad_accion_actualizar_polit: Ask Systems for a compatible policy or destination.
copias_seguridad_accion_preparar_release: Prepare a current release and a tested procedure.
copias_seguridad_accion_actualizar_forma: Use a format supported by the checker.
